summary: @jonbecker Trust me I know. My track record for 2019 was abysmal. Only 10k for over two million in solicitations, but they were all first time submissions. The grant system just as systemically racist and sexist as rest of #highered if not worse

body_html:
@jonbecker Trust me I know. My track record for 2019 was abysmal. Only 10k for over two million in solicitations, but they were all first time submissions.

The grant system just as systemically racist and sexist as rest of #highered if not worse
